source.author: cic
source.text: habeo enim regulam, ut talia visa vera iudicem qualia falsa esse non possint; ab hac mihi non licet transversum ut aiunt digitum discedere, ne confundam omnia; veri enim et falsi non modo cognitio sed etiam natura tolletur, si nihil erit quod intersit.
source.text_original: habeo enim regulam, ut talia visa vera iudicem qualia falsa esse non possint; ab hac mihi non licet transversum ut aiunt digitum discedere, ne confundam omnia; veri enim et falsi non modo cognitio sed etiam natura tolletur, si nihil erit quod intersit.
source.text_english: For I have a rule, that I judge such appearances to be true as cannot possibly be false; from this I am not allowed, as they say, to move a finger’s breadth aside, lest I throw everything into confusion; for not only will the knowledge but even the nature of truth and falsehood be abolished, if there is nothing that makes a difference.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Et quia nobis de portu egredientibus quasi quidam scopulus opponitur, ne possimus ad pelagi tuta decurrere, et apostoli Pauli scribentis ad Timotheum profertur auctoritas, in qua de uiduis disputans ait: uolo autem iuniores nubere, filios procreare, matres familias esse, nullam occasionem dare aduersario maledicti gratia; iam enim quaedam abierunt retro post satanan, oportet primum sensum tractare praecepti et omnem loci huius continentiam discutere atque ita apostolicis uestigiis insistentem ne transuersum quidem, ut dici solet, unguem in partem alteram declinare.
reuse.text_original: Et quia nobis de portu egredientibus quasi quidam scopulus opponitur, ne possimus ad pelagi tuta decurrere, et apostoli Pauli scribentis ad Timotheum profertur auctoritas, in qua de uiduis disputans ait: uolo autem iuniores nubere, filios procreare, matres familias esse, nullam occasionem dare aduersario maledicti gratia; iam enim quaedam abierunt retro post satanan, oportet primum sensum tractare praecepti et omnem loci huius continentiam discutere atque ita apostolicis uestigiis insistentem ne transuersum quidem, ut dici solet, unguem in partem alteram declinare.
reuse.text_english: And because, as we are sailing out of the harbor, some rock is set in our way so that we cannot run to the safety of the open sea, and the authority of the apostle Paul is brought forward, who in writing to Timothy says, when discussing widows, I wish younger women to marry, bear children, and be mistresses of households, giving the adversary no occasion for reproach; for some have already turned back after Satan, we must first consider the sense of the command and examine the whole context of this passage, and only then, following the apostolic footsteps, must we not even turn, as the saying goes, a nail’s breadth aside in the other direction.
